title: Jump shot
description: Jump shot form, filmed from the shooting-hand side. Exact port of jump_shot.py.
success: Clean shot: good dip, set point, extension and follow-through.

feedback.fail_high: Bend your knees more before you shoot. Your power comes from your legs.
feedback.fail_low: You're sinking too low. A smaller dip keeps the shot quick.

feedback.fail_high: Your elbow is too open at the set point. Bring the ball back so your elbow is near 90°.
feedback.fail_low: Your elbow is too tight at the set point. Let it open toward 90°.
feedback.fail_missing: No set point found: bring the ball up above your shoulder before you shoot, don't push it from your chest.

feedback.fail: Fully extend your arm at release, reach up toward the rim.

feedback.fail_low: You're pushing the ball forward. Shoot up at the rim: your arm should finish pointing high.
feedback.fail_high: Your arm is going straight up. Aim slightly forward toward the rim.

feedback.fail: Hold your follow-through: keep your wrist up after the ball leaves your hand.
